_about: Thresholds for the factory's routing (Get-Route in scripts/factory/Triage.psm1). The factory reads this file from main before any agent runs. Changes are the owner's call and come with updated replay cases in tests/factory/routing-cases.json. limits, suspended, reinstated and startingTargets come from the command center spec (planning/work/command-center/spec.md): suspended lists areas (folders under src/FlareAI.Core/ or src/FlareAI.Flare/) where fixes go for review; reinstated maps an area to the date the owner reinstated it, so reverts before then no longer suspend it; startingTargets are days per class of service until a class has 10 finished items. limits.featureLoop and limits.vmBatch are placeholders the command center shows; nothing enforces them yet.
